{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the 'revenue' column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify internal test orders
# Based on the data, orders with revenue = '999,999.99' are likely test orders
# These are 6 rows, all with status 'completed'
test_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999,999.99']

# Also check if there are any other suspicious patterns
# No other obvious indicators, so we assume these 6 are the only test orders

# Now, filter for completed orders that are not test orders
completed_non_test = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue'] != '999,999.99')]

# Calculate total revenue from these orders
total_revenue = completed_non_test['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Print the result
total_revenue"}
